  "correction_rules": [
    "Model tends to overestimate prices in early periods (first 5-7 days) after spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Underestimates prices when sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) — adjust downward by 2-5% of forecasted value.",
    "Overreacts to recent high prices (last 3-5 days) — apply a 10-15% downward correction if forecast exceeds true outcome by >10%.",
    "Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-8% to align with historical volatility.",
